short: Intuitive Somatic Coaching for deep transformation around identity, creating a safe home in yourself through your own innate creative energy. For those in life transitions, seeking support finding themselves again, battling self-doubt, lostness, or unmet needs.
training: Uncertified somatic experiencing and IFS training through each entity’s educational programs. Various uncertified training in nervous system regulation, neurobiology, polyvagal theory, and breathwork techniques. Eight years of formal vocal training, MFA in creative writing, professional visual artist in multiple mediums. Twenty five years in coaching.
pricing: Free 30-Min Consult, $250 per 60-minute session. Weekly or twice a month.
long:
Intuitive Somatic Coaching for deep transformation around identity, creating a safe home in yourself through your own innate creative energy. For those in life transitions, seeking support finding themselves again, battling self-doubt, lostness, or unmet needs. Reach out if you are looking to be deeply witnessed and given attuned support to create the life you’ve been longing for.

Ellee Achten is a multidisciplinary creative, masterclass instructor, and intuitive somatic coach informed by Somatic Experiencing, Internal Family Systems (IFS) parts work, and Attachment Theory. She is a formally trained vocalist, MFA-holding creative writer, and professional visual artist. She has spent the last 25+ years helping people move past self-criticism, reconnect with their intuition, and live with more ease and clarity.

Website: www.elleeachten.com

Ellee Achten Coaching (Patreon): www.patreon.com/elleeachten

*********I am not a licensed therapist or medical provider. My work is coaching-based and focuses on creative exploration, nervous system awareness, and personal insight.
size: 5-7 pribate clients. I do other programs like retreats and workshops. I keep my client base small in order to provide deep presence for corrective experiences to occur.
